PRADESHIYA SABHAS ACT, No. 15 OF 1987
Order

BY virtue of the powers vested in me by sub-section(c) of Section 9A of the Pradeshiya Sabhas Act, No. 15 of 1987 to be readwith Section 2 of the same, I, Faiszer Musthapha, Minister of Provincial Councils and Local Government, hereby dissolve,the Ambagamuwa Pradeshiya Sabha constituted by the Order published in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 453/10 of the 12thMay of 1987 with effect from the 14th day of February, 2018, in order to constitute the new Pradeshiya Sabhas, whichshall be henceforth cited as the Maskeliya Pradeshiya Sabha, Norwood Pradeshiya Sabha and Ambagamuwa PradeshiyaSabha.
FAISZER MUSTHAPHA,Minister of Provincial Councils and Local Government.
Colombo,On the 01st day of November, 2017.
